reason: I buy my parts in the market myself, shop by shop, and my electrician wires it; I know these people and I can bargain with them face to face. An app sending me offers from companies I don't know doesn't beat that, and a written price from a company is usually higher than what I get haggling.
objection: A photo of a label proves nothing; fake panels and weak batteries in the market come with good-looking labels. How would an app sitting somewhere know if the battery is really the capacity it says?
would_change_my_mind: If a shop owner I know in my area told me they used it and the system held up through the cuts, or if the check could actually test that a battery or panel is genuine, not just read the sticker.
